text.name: X4 UI Rework - Meridian Theme
text.description: A clean, modern recolour and readability overhaul of the entire X4 Foundations UI and HUD: menus, panels, buttons, crosshair, holomap, target monitor, message ticker and more. Non-destructive colour patch only, safe alongside almost any other extension. Complements kuertee's UI Extensions and HUD.
text.author: St3ve109
